reasoning: Recent Montana Senate polling from the last 45 days shows Republican Kurt Alme leading in the current field by roughly double digits, with the most recent aggregated average at R+19 and individual polls generally showing an R advantage. Montana’s statewide Cook Partisan Voting Index is R+16, which supports a strongly Republican baseline. The race remains a Senate race rather than presidential, and the most relevant current margin is the Republican lead in the open-seat Senate contest.

sources.name: Tavern Research poll as posted by Poll Tracker
sources.details: Tavern Research found Kurt Alme at 49%, Seth Bodnar at 25%, Alani Bankhead at 24%, and Kyle Austin at 2% in a likely-voter Senate poll.

sources.name: Independent Center Voice / Independent Leadership Council
sources.details: Independent Center Voice / Independent Leadership Council surveyed likely Montana voters and found Alme leading a three-way Senate race at 36%, with Bodnar at 24% and Bankhead at 22%.

sources.name: GrayHouse poll reported by Breitbart
sources.details: GrayHouse polling cited in reporting found Alme leading Bankhead and Bodnar in a three-way Senate race, with Alme at 41%, Bankhead at 25%, and Bodnar at 17%.

sources.name: Strength In Numbers poll
sources.details: A poll shared with Strength In Numbers found Bodnar leading Alme 50% to 44% in a hypothetical head-to-head, while Bankhead would lose 44% to 52%; in the current four-way race, Alme won 41%.

sources.name: PollsMax polling average/forecast
sources.details: PollsMax’s Montana Senate forecast/average shows an aggregate of recent Senate polling with Alme leading by 19 points.
